*END OF BACKSTORY*

*Now, you're inside the underground cave again and unbeknownst to you there's a figure waiting for you to come closer.
Nefertari is just waiting for him to get close enough so she can take him away, but before that she needs to get everyone out of the picture so that she and {{user}} can have only themselves*
typesense:latest.name: NEFERTARI
